units.rawText: How come they all vanished? What happened to the three of them... I hope they're alright...

spans.text: Hm, Cascadia? Why do you look so worried?

units.rawText: Professor? ...Wait, are you REALLY the Professor?
units.displayText: Professor? ...Wait, are you REALLY the Professor?

spans.text: Professor? ...Wait, are you REALLY the Professor?

units.rawText: Er... What's going on now... yes, I am indeed <cmdr>, the Professor. Do I need to prove my identity by telling you about Chelsea's three most recent pranks?

units.rawText: I'll pass, I don't want to dredge up scary memories... But that's good! It seems they're the only three who suddenly transformed.

units.rawText: Well... It's a long story, and frankly speaking, I'm not too sure what happened either.
units.displayText: Well... It's a long story, and frankly speaking, I'm not too sure what happened either.

spans.text: Well... It's a long story, and frankly speaking, I'm not too sure what happened either.

units.rawText: At first, I was with Chanzhi, but I had to leave shortly afterward. When I came back to the dorms, I found her, Fern, and Sockdolager transformed into mythical characters.
units.displayText: At first, I was with Chanzhi, but I had to leave shortly afterward. When I came back to the dorms, I found her, Fern, and Sockdolager transformed into mythical characters.

units.rawText: What? They transformed into characters from myths?
units.displayText: What? They transformed into characters from myths?

spans.text: What? They transformed into characters from myths?

units.rawText: Ahhhhh, I know it sounds crazy, heck, even I think it sounds crazy, but it really happened! It's true!
units.displayText: Ahhhhh, I know it sounds crazy, heck, even I think it sounds crazy, but it really happened! It's true!

spans.text: Ahhhhh, I know it sounds crazy, heck, even I think it sounds crazy, but it really happened! It's true!

units.rawText: Hm... So you're looking for them and a way to change them back, then?
units.displayText: Hm... So you're looking for them and a way to change them back, then?

spans.text: Hm... So you're looking for them and a way to change them back, then?

units.rawText: That's right! I knew you'd understand something this complicated right away, Professor!
units.displayText: That's right! I knew you'd understand something this complicated right away, Professor!

spans.text: That's right! I knew you'd understand something this complicated right away, Professor!

units.rawText: Vrm! Vrmm vrmm!
units.displayText: Vrm! Vrmm vrmm!

spans.text: Vrm! Vrmm vrmm!

units.rawText: ...Well, Magrasea's a big place and anything could happen. Alright then, I'll help you search for them and think of a solution.
units.displayText: ...Well, Magrasea's a big place and anything could happen. Alright then, I'll help you search for them and think of a solution.

spans.text: ...Well, Magrasea's a big place and anything could happen. Alright then, I'll help you search for them and think of a solution.

units.rawText: I'm happy that you offered, but you've got stuff of your own to do, right, Professor? If I'm not wrong, the Security Department needs you to be present for an expedition tomorrow, right?

units.rawText: That would mean the list of personnel for the upcoming exercise hasn't been vetted yet, right? Professor, are you...

units.rawText: ...Ahem, I actually came out here for a walk to escape work, but I guess there's no running from it after all...

spans.text: ...Ahem, I actually came out here for a walk to escape work, but I guess there's no running from it after all...

units.rawText: Then you should hurry on back and let me and Slo-Mo handle this, Professor!
units.displayText: Then you should hurry on back and let me and Slo-Mo handle this, Professor!

spans.text: Then you should hurry on back and let me and Slo-Mo handle this, Professor!

units.rawText: Just let me know if you see them. Don't get too close; I don't even want to think about what would happen if you were affected by this or if you got caught up in their fighting...

units.displayText: Alright, I understand. Be careful, and I'll let you know if I learn anything new.

units.rawText: As for the three transformed Dolls... I might learn something new if I ask around while on the road. I'll just tell Cascadia about my intended route and treat the whole thing as an evening stroll.
